headline: Tightening subdivision and sale of urban plots: Is the era of 'hoarding land' waiting for price rises coming to an end?
summary: Restrictions on subdividing and selling land plots in major cities are expected to shape the coming real estate market. Higher holding costs for unused land and greater transparency in land prices are also expected.
why: Land and real estate rules affect property developers and the housing market, which feed into construction, banking credit and household wealth.
